yogaFaqs.question: Can I attend a batch other than my chosen slot?
yogaFaqs.answer: Yes! Your chosen slot sets your calendar notification, but you can attend any of the 8 batches morning or evening using the same single pass.

yogaFaqs.question: Does watching a recording count toward my streak?
yogaFaqs.answer: No. Per the single-source rule, live session participation counts toward streaks to foster genuine daily practice consistency.

yogaFaqs.question: Can I join from WhatsApp or only the app?
yogaFaqs.answer: Both fire to the exact same attendance ledger! Tapping the WhatsApp class link updates your app streak automatically.
